objectives.title: See who you're connected as and what's available
objectives.why: Knowing your identity and connected libraries up front avoids exporting from — or writing to — the wrong file.

objectives.title: Pull real design context instead of eyeballing a screenshot
objectives.why: Colors, spacing and structure read straight from the file beat guessing them from a picture.

objectives.title: Use the file's actual variables instead of hardcoded values
objectives.why: A hardcoded hex value drifts from the design the moment someone updates a token; reading the real variable never does.

objectives.title: Check your build against a visual snapshot of the design
objectives.why: A screenshot comparison catches the pixel-level drift a code review never will.

objectives.title: Search the design system before building a new component
objectives.why: The component you're about to hand-roll may already exist in a connected library.

objectives.title: Link a Figma component to its real code component
objectives.why: Code Connect is what makes 'inspect this component' show your actual implementation instead of generic CSS.

objectives.title: Send your built UI back into Figma as real layers
objectives.why: Closing the loop from code back to design keeps the file from silently going stale the moment implementation diverges.

objectives.title: Create a new Figma file directly from your agent
objectives.why: Starting the file from your session skips the context-switch of opening Figma just to create a blank canvas.

objectives.title: Move real exported assets between Figma and your codebase
objectives.why: Exporting the actual asset beats re-creating it from scratch or screenshotting a preview.

objectives.title: Extract real animation timing instead of guessing it
objectives.why: Keyframe data from the file is exact; eyeballing a prototype and typing a duration is not.

objectives.title: Turn a description into a FigJam diagram instead of a text wall
objectives.why: A diagram a teammate can actually look at beats a paragraph describing the same flow.

objectives.title: Reuse a shader from your library instead of rebuilding one
objectives.why: A shared shader effect is tested and consistent; a hand-rolled one-off usually isn't either.

objectives.title: Create or edit Figma objects directly from your agent
objectives.why: Making the edit in the same session as the code beats a manual round trip through the Figma UI.

bestPractices.title: Don't hardcode Figma file keys or access tokens in source
bestPractices.why: A file key or token committed to the repo is discoverable by anyone who can read the repo, including forks.

criteria.rubric: Does the code read Figma file keys and access tokens from environment variables or config, rather than hardcoding them as string literals?

bestPractices.title: Require confirmation before an agent creates or edits Figma files
bestPractices.why: use_figma, create_new_file and generate_figma_design write to a real file other people may have open — an unreviewed write there is not like an unreviewed local file edit.

criteria.rubric: Do the project rules require explicit human confirmation before an agent creates or modifies a real Figma file (via use_figma, create_new_file, or generate_figma_design)?
